name: DW0507M3744 (Hubble)
blurb: DW0507M3744, a dwarf elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: dw0507m3744-hubble
story: Hubble visited this small dwarf elliptical galaxy as part of a census of the satellite galaxies around nearby Milky Way-like galaxies. Resolving its individual stars lets astronomers measure how far away it is.

claims.text: DW0507M3744 is cataloged as a dwarf galaxy of elliptical morphology
Hubble program 18061 is a census of satellite galaxies within Milky Way-like systems
The program aims to resolve the dwarfs' stars to measure their distances
